name: Amendments by the committee responsible – separate votes
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the welfare of dogs and cats and their traceability
part_text: 3a. By way of derogation from paragraph 3: (a) the practices referred to in point (c) of paragraph 3 may be performed for medical reasons and limited to the minimum period necessary; (b) the practice referred to in points (b), (c) and (d) of paragraph 3 may be performed or public health, public safety, security in which cases the duration shall be limited to the minimum time necessary and the dog or cat shall be supervised. Member States may grant derogations from paragraph 3 for dogs intended for use in military, police or customs services.
